name: Covarion.Galtier01
title: The Galtier (2001) Covarion Model

citation.title: Maximum-likelihood phylogenetic analysis under a covarion-like model

args.name: nu
args.description: Controls the rate of switching between components.

args.name: method
args.description: `AlwaysSwitch` keeps the supplied switching rates; `MetropolisSwitching` can preserve component and character frequencies by reducing switching rates.

description:
Allows a fraction pi of sites to switch between rate categories along the tree. The remaining sites retain a single rate category throughout the tree. Both fractions use the supplied mixture; the historical model uses discrete Gamma rate categories.

With AlwaysSwitch, the rate from category i to category j is nu times the weight of category j. The switching methods coincide when component equilibrium frequencies are equal. With different frequencies, `AlwaysSwitch` can require a rooted tree even when the input models are reversible.
